name: Puchi Fan Disc Mitai na no
original_name: ぷちファンディスクみたいなの
source: Contains the usual extra omake stuff one would expect from NekoNeko Soft to Sanarara and Lamune, and has an exclusive introductory section to Scarlett (interview with the heroines and the writer's comments about the product).
translation: 收录猫猫社一贯会为《Sanarara》和《弹珠汽水》准备的附赠内容，另有《Scarlett》独占的先行介绍环节，包括女主角访谈和编剧对作品的评论。
